name: proposal-norm
description: The release-engineering phase-1 norm, alone: every docs/issue-<n>/proposals/*.md is RFC-shaped (scope/change description, a named risk, a rollback/back-out path, at least one sourced-evidence citation) before it may be written, enforced by proposal-fields-gate.sh on every Write/Edit/MultiEdit to a proposal document.

dependencies.note: Requires the core plugin from tokenmaxxxer-core installed alongside this plugin.
